holdout_lon.note: NO longitude is held out of training by this codec (holdout_lon '0,0' is the empty interval), so every scope aggregate is already the trained-pixel number. The *_holdlon children are present and EMPTY by construction -- n_px 0, no rows, no horizon_auc -- and the *_trainlon children are their parents exactly. Read the parent.

gate_ref.head: e017_u1_s0
gate_ref.reason: no validation-gate reference exists at pentad cadence. The e017_u1_s0 reference (auc 0.643, bands h1-3 0.47, h4-6 0.375, h7-12 0.492) was measured by ml/rollout.py over the MONTHLY family-3 axis (#217); it cannot certify a roll whose steps are a different length, whose starts are a different count and whose horizon bands span different durations. Passing it here would be a certificate for an experiment nobody ran. The numbers below are therefore UNCERTIFIED: report them as a first reading, and register a reference for this cadence in GATE_REF_BY_CADENCE once one has been measured and published.

cadence.name: pentad
cadence.note: every `h` in this file is an AXIS STEP, not a month. The horizon-band keys carry their own day spans for the same reason. `horizon_auc` averages msss_clim over h=1..horizon_steps and is therefore a function of THIS axis's lead sampling; `horizon_auc_daymatched` averages the twelve leads above, which are the monthly archive's, and is the ONLY one of the two that may be compared against an archived corridor AUC.

starts.rule: every k-th start of the holdout year's list, k = len(list)//N, first N — deterministic, keeps the start whose h=1 is the year's first row, and spreads the rest evenly round the seasonal cycle
